subject.title: Compaction should use auth-profile rotation / failover within the same provider

question: Should compaction adopt same-provider auth-profile retry for auto-selected profiles, with stable transcript/apply-once semantics as the required safety boundary?
rationale: The behavior matches normal-run failover, but compaction mutates session transcripts, so maintainers need to confirm the retry boundary before this becomes the permanent contract.

options.title: Adopt safe same-provider compaction retry
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent replacement that keeps user-pinned profiles locked and retries only against a stable compaction snapshot.

options.title: Keep compaction strict
options.body: Reject auth-profile retry for compaction and update docs/user guidance so compaction failures remain explicit instead of rotating credentials.

options.title: Defer to broader auth redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open as a product/design task and hold the linked PR until compaction, provider routing, and auth fallback are redesigned together.

recommendation.title: Adopt safe same-provider compaction retry
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent replacement that keeps user-pinned profiles locked and retries only against a stable compaction snapshot.
